1.text: Imyaka ibiri ishize, Farawo arota ahagaze iruhande rw'uruzi.

2.text: Mu ruzi havamo inka ndwi z'igikundiro zibyibushye, zirishiriza mu mifunzo.

3.text: Izindi nka ndwi z'umwaku zinanutse zirazikurikira, ziva mu ruzi zihagararana na za zindi ku nkombe y'uruzi.

4.text: Za nka z'umwaku zinanutse, zirya za zindi z'igikundiro zibyibushye uko ari indwi. Farawo aribambura.

5.text: Arongera aribīkīra arota inzozi za kabiri, ngo amahundo arindwi ahunze meza, ameze ku giti kimwe.

6.text: Maze andi mahundo arindwi y'iminambe yumishijwe n'umuyaga uva iburasirazuba, akurikiraho aramera.

7.text: Ayo mahundo y'iminambe amira ya mahundo ahunze atsibaze, uko ari arindwi. Farawo aribambura, amenya yuko ari inzozi.

8.text: Mu gitondo ahagarika umutima, ahamagaza abakonikoni ba Egiputa bose n'abanyabwenge baho bose. Farawo abarotorera inzozi ze, ntihagira ubasha kuzisobanurira Farawo.

9.text: Maze umuhereza wa vino mukuru abwira Farawo ati “Uyu munsi ndakwibutsa ibyaha byanjye.

10.text: Farawo yarakariye abagaragu be andindishiriza mu nzu y'umutware w'abamurinda, jye n'umuvuzi w'imitsima mukuru.

11.text: Turotera ijoro rimwe twembi, turota inzozi zisobanurwa ukubiri.

12.text: Twari kumwe n'umuhungu w'Umuheburayo, umugurano w'umutware w'abakurinda, tumurotorera inzozi zacu arazidusobanurira, asobanurira umuntu wese nk'uko inzozi ze ziri.

13.text: Kandi uko yabidusobanuriye ni ko byasohoye, Farawo yansubije mu butware bwanjye, wa wundi aramumanika.”

14.text: Maze Farawo ahamagaza Yosefu, bamuhubura mu nzu y'imbohe, ariyogoshesha yambara indi myenda, yinjira aho Farawo ari.

15.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Narose none nta wushobora kuzisobanura. Numvise bavuga yuko ubasha gusobanura inzozi bakurotoreye.”

16.text: Yosefu asubiza Farawo ati “Si jye, Imana ni yo iri busubize Farawo amagambo y'amahoro.”

17.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Narose mpagaze ku nkombe y'uruzi,

18.text: havamo inka ndwi zibyibushye z'igikundiro zirishiriza mu mifunzo,

19.text: maze zikurikirwa n'izindi nka ndwi zizamuka zonze, ari umwaku zinanutse cyane. Sinari nabona inka mbi nk'izo mu gihugu cya Egiputa hose.

20.text: Izo nka zinanutse z'umwaku zirya za nka zibyibushye zabanje uko ari indwi,

21.text: zimaze kuzirya, ntiwamenya yuko ziziriye, ziguma kuba umwaku nk'ubwa mbere. Nuko ndakanguka.

22.text: Kandi ndota ngo amahundo arindwi atsibaze meza, ameze ku giti kimwe,

23.text: maze andi mahundo arindwi yumye y'iminambe, yumishijwe n'umuyaga uva iburasirazuba akurikiraho aramera,

24.text: ayo mahundo y'iminambe amira ya mahundo meza uko ari arindwi. Nzirotorera abakonikoni, ntihagira ubasha kuzinsobanurira.”

25.text: Yosefu abwira Farawo ati “Inzozi za Farawo ni zimwe: ibyo Imana igiye gukora yabibwiye Farawo.

26.text: Za nka ndwi nziza ni imyaka irindwi, na ya mahundo arindwi meza ni imyaka irindwi. Inzozi ni zimwe.

27.text: Na za nka zinanutse z'umwaku zazikurikiye ni imyaka irindwi, na ya mahundo arindwi y'imishishi yumishijwe n'umuyaga uva iburasirazuba na yo ni imyaka irindwi. Izaba imyaka irindwi y'inzara.

28.text: Icyo ni cyo nabwiye Farawo nti ‘Ibyo Imana igiye gukora yabibwiye Farawo.’

29.text: Hazaza imyaka irindwi y'uburumbuke bwinshi mu gihugu cya Egiputa cyose,

30.text: hanyuma hazakurikiraho imyaka irindwi y'inzara, ubwo burumbuke bwose bwibagirane mu gihugu cya Egiputa. Inzara izamara igihugu,

31.text: uburumbuke bwe kwibukwa ku bw'inzara ibukurikiye, kuko izaba nyinshi cyane.

32.text: Kandi icyatumye izo nzozi zibonekera Farawo kabiri, ni uko ibyo byakomejwe n'Imana kandi izabisohoza vuba.

33.text: “Nuko Farawo nashake umuntu w'umunyabwenge w'umuhanga, amuhe ubutware bw'igihugu cya Egiputa.

34.text: Farawo ashyireho abahunikisha, ahunikishe igice cya gatanu cy'ubutaka bwa Egiputa mu myaka y'uburumbuke, uko ari irindwi.

35.text: Bateranye ibihunikwa by'iyo myaka myiza igiye gutaha, bahunike mu midugudu imyaka y'impeke izatunga abantu, itegekwe na Farawo, bayirinde.

36.text: Kandi ibyo bihunikwa bizabera igihugu ibibikiwe imyaka irindwi y'inzara izatera mu gihugu cya Egiputa, igihugu cye kumarwa n'inzara.”

37.text: Iyo nama inezeza Farawo n'abagaragu be bose.

38.text: Farawo abaza abagaragu be ati “Tuzabona hehe umuntu umeze nk'uyu, urimo umwuka w'Imana?”

39.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Kuko Imana ikweretse ibyo byose nta wundi munyabwenge w'umuhanga muhwanye,

40.text: nguhaye gutwara urugo rwanjye kandi abantu banjye bose bazumvire icyo utegetse, ku ntebe yanjye y'ubwami yonyine nzagusumba.”

41.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Dore nkweguriye igihugu cya Egiputa cyose.”

42.text: Farawo yiyambura impeta iriho ikimenyetso yo ku rutoki rwe ayambika Yosefu ku rutoki, amwambika imyenda y'ibitare byiza, amwambika n'umukufi w'izahabu mu ijosi,

43.text: amugendeshereza mu igare rikurikira irye bakajya bamurangana bati “Nimumupfukamire!” Nuko amwegurira igihugu cya Egiputa cyose.

44.text: Farawo abwira Yosefu ati “Jye Farawo ndahiriye ko nta wuzunamura ukuboko, nta wuzashingura ikirenge, mu gihugu cya Egiputa cyose utabyemeye.”

45.text: Farawo ahimba Yosefu Safunatipāneya, amushyingira Asenati mwene Potifera, umutambyi wo mu mudugudu wa Oni. Yosefu atambagira igihugu cya Egiputa.

46.text: Yosefu yari amaze imyaka mirongo itatu avutse, ubwo yakoreraga Farawo. Yosefu ava aho Farawo ari, atambagira igihugu cya Egiputa cyose.

47.text: Mu myaka y'uburumbuke uko ari irindwi, igihugu kirera gisenyukamo imyaka.

48.text: Ahunikisha ibihunikwa byose byo mu gihugu cya Egiputa uko iyo myaka irindwi ingana, abihunika mu midugudu, imyaka yo mu mirima ikikije umudugudu wose ayihunika muri wo.

49.text: Yosefu ahunika imyaka y'impeke myinshi cyane ihwanye n'umusenyi wo ku nyanja, ageza aho yarorereye kubara kuko itabarikaga.

50.text: Yosefu abyara abahungu babiri inzara itaratera, ababyarana na Asenati mwene Potifera, umutambyi wo mu mudugudu wa Oni.

51.text: Yosefu yita imfura ye Manase ati “Ni uko Imana yanyibagije umuruho wanjye wose w'inzu ya data yose.”

52.text: Uwa kabiri amwita Efurayimu ati “Ni uko Imana yanyororokereje mu gihugu nabonyemo umubabaro.”

53.text: Ya myaka irindwi y'uburumbuke bwabaye mu gihugu cya Egiputa irashira.

54.text: Imyaka irindwi y'inzara itangira gutaha nk'uko Yosefu yari yarabivuze, inzara itera mu bihugu byose ariko mu gihugu cya Egiputa cyose bo bafite ibyokurya.

55.text: Igihugu cya Egiputa cyose kibabajwe n'inzara, batakambira Farawo ngo abahe ibyo barya. Farawo abwira Abanyegiputa bose ati “Nimusange Yosefu, mukore icyo abategeka.”

56.text: Inzara ikwira mu bihugu byose, Yosefu akingura ubuhuniko bwose ahahisha Abanyegiputa, inzara irakomera cyane mu gihugu cya Egiputa.

57.text: Abo mu bihugu byose bajya muri Egiputa kuri Yosefu guhaha imyaka y'impeke, kuko inzara yari nyinshi mu bihugu byose.
